tool.nav_bit_sync.description: GPS 50 bps bit synchronization: locate bit boundaries by coherent accumulation and decide bits. Returns in_sync=False with an honest reason when the sync evidence is insufficient (low SNR or non-nav stream) — never fabricates synchronization.
tool.subframe_assemble.description: Bit stream to 300-bit subframe sequence with explicit TLM/HOW/parity-chain validation per subframe; trailing partial segments are counted and reported honestly, never silently swallowed.
tool.how_validate.description: Per-field TLM/HOW subframe validation: 0x8B preamble, parity chain, SFID range; reports TOW, alert flag and anti-spoof flag.
